mapper.select: SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidates (id,user_id,display_name,current_resume_id) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{displayName},#{currentResumeId}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET user_id=EXCLUDED.user_id,display_name=EXCLUDED.display_name,current_resume_id=EXCLUDED.current_resume_id
